name: Jefferson County, AR
findings: Jefferson County has 264 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Jefferson County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Jefferson County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
